svg.title: Rigorous Mandelbrot exterior certificate
svg.desc: A 0.004-radius already certified blue disk, plus 207 certified green squares and nine uncertified orange squares in the surrounding annulus. The outer dashed circle indicates the sampling bound, not the actual Mandelbrot boundary.

g.text: Finite exact certification in the parameter plane

svg.text: Both axes show parameter displacement; no Mandelbrot boundary is drawn.
